title: dataLayer push is a GA4 purchase event (single condition, demonstration)

claim.statement: The dataLayer push captured for the checkout-complete step is a GA4 `purchase` event (its `event` is exactly "purchase").

question.instructions: The state is one dataLayer push as JSON. Which GA4 event is it?

notes: Measured on the pinned checkpoint, CPU fp32, eval mode, one state per forward pass: formulation `choice5_events` chosen on the calibration split only (highest accuracy, then lowest NLL at the fitted temperature). Held-out accuracy 0.811 (n=180); ECE (15 bins) 0.097 raw logits, 0.075 at the checkpoint's shipped temperature, 0.053 at the fitted temperature 1.404; at verify 0.90 / refute 0.90, coverage 0.717 (VERIFIED 80, REFUTED 49, INCONCLUSIVE 51) with gated precision 0.953 (Wilson 95% lower bound 0.902). Calibration split: accuracy 0.806, ECE after fitting 0.072 (n=180). Dataset: test/fixtures/system1-calibration/single-condition/gtm-event-is-purchase/ (report: docs/calibration/system1-calibration-report.md, Hybrid section).

Formulations tried: noul: calibration accuracy 0.639, NLL 0.610 at T 6.613; held-out accuracy 0.617; choice2_neutral: calibration accuracy 0.644, NLL 0.568 at T 3.243; held-out accuracy 0.606; choice5_events: calibration accuracy 0.806, NLL 0.509 at T 1.404; held-out accuracy 0.811. Controls at the fitted T: CTL-GTM-PURCHASE-VALID VERIFIED->VERIFIED (p=0.977); CTL-GTM-PURCHASE-NO-CURRENCY VERIFIED->VERIFIED (p=0.981); CTL-GTM-ADD-TO-CART REFUTED->REFUTED (p=0.995). Replay: 5 runs per control (2 in fresh processes), max thresholded-probability delta 0, max logit delta 0; epsilon is 10x the larger of the measured delta and the delta the worst logit wobble seen on any checkpoint would cause at this temperature, rounded up.

Temperature semantics: `calibration.temperature` replaces the checkpoint's own temperature for this question's (type, option count) bucket, i.e. probabilities are softmax(option logits / T); a runner sets agent.temperature_by_options[temp_bucket] = T and passes no `lang`. `measured_ece` is the larger of the calibration-split and held-out ECE at the fitted temperature.
Held-out accuracy by variant: near_miss 0.05, other_event 0.81, purchase 1.00.

Demonstration of a single-condition question where Laya works. The selection guide routes this exact check to the `validator` backend (RUB-S1-VAL-GTM-PURCHASE-EVENT decides it, and the five other purchase conditions, exactly); do not bind a new claim to this rubric where the validator applies.

Held-out items include near-miss spellings (Purchase, PURCHASE, purchase_complete, order_completed, purchased, checkout_purchase) labeled as not purchase, because the condition is `event` exactly equal to "purchase". Held-out statuses by variant: near_miss INCONCLUSIVE 16, VERIFIED 6; other_event INCONCLUSIVE 19, REFUTED 49; purchase INCONCLUSIVE 16, VERIFIED 74. Every wrong gated verdict is a near-miss spelling VERIFIED as purchase; the model never REFUTES one. The bar is met on this mix (about one item in eight a near miss) and would not be on a population with more near misses.
Assurance-eligible: held-out gated precision 0.953 >= 0.95 with Wilson lower bound 0.902 >= 0.90, every control on its expected status in every replay run, measured ECE 0.072 <= max_ece 0.10.
